plain_summary: This page details the fees for various emergency services provided by Fire and Emergency Services. It lists turn-out fees for heavy and light duty fire tenders and Hazmat vehicles, as well as fees for the use of fire tenders, Hazmat vehicles, equipment, and crew, charged per half hour. It also specifies fees for additional fire fighting staff, standby duty, use of portable equipment like pumps and generators, and additional breathing apparatus sets. The page defines conditions A, B, and C which refer to whether a fire, Hazmat incident, or rescue/salvage operation has been resolved upon the arrival of emergency services.

calculation_relevant_numbers.context: Fire tender turn-out fee — Heavy duty; Hazmat vehicle turn-out — Heavy duty
Fire tender turn-out fee — Light duty; Hazmat vehicle turn-out — Light duty
Use of fire tender, equipment and crew per half hour; Use of Hazmat vehicle, equipment and crew per half hour
Additional fire fighting staff fee per half hour; Fire fighter on standby duty per half hour
Use of portable fire pump, chemical transfer pump, generator, 'veld fire' pump, bobcat including fire fighter per half hour
Use of additional breathing apparatus per set
